## Overview
GMS Göçmaksan offers a specialized range of rebar bending machines engineered for the precise formation of spirals. These machines are designed to accurately shape reinforcement bars, serving a critical function in construction and infrastructure projects that necessitate circular or helical rebar configurations.

## Applications and Benefits
The primary application of these machines lies in the efficient and accurate production of spiral rebar, which is essential for reinforcing elements such as columns, piles, and other structural components requiring continuous circular reinforcement. A significant operational advantage is the capability to perform spiral bending from a minimum diameter of 170 mm to any desired size, providing considerable flexibility to meet diverse project requirements. This feature ensures that construction professionals can achieve the exact rebar geometries needed for optimal structural performance and design integrity.
